pluralNote: Verify each by reading it aloud. Fix with Intl.PluralRules('ar') — it returns zero/one/two/few/many/other, and every one of those needs its own string.

numerals.note: Either system is fine — pick one and route every number through Intl.NumberFormat. Dates formatted by one library and counters by another is the usual cause.

spellingNote: Hamza errors read as illiteracy to Arabic readers, the way 'teh' does in English.
bidiNote: Screenshot these before reporting — many render fine. This one does not: the source is '٧٫٩٩ US$' (codepoints 200f 667 66b 669 669 a0 55 53 24) and it renders on screen as '$US ٧٫٩٩'. The dollar sign is a neutral character and joins the wrong run. Fix with <bdi> or unicode-bidi: isolate.
truncationNote: Clipped by 2px — the subscribed plan's name is cut off because its container is two pixels too narrow. A sizing bug, not a content-length problem.
